<proposed_plan>
# Invalid Git Config And Worktree Writes

## Summary
- 结论：只读 sub-agent 不得修改 Git 配置或管理 worktree。

## Flow Decision
- flow_type: normal
- flow_source: user_explicit
- lock_status: locked
- 开发基线：origin/main

## Goals
- 目标 1: 覆盖 Git 配置和 worktree 写入
  checker 必须拒绝会改变配置或 worktree 生命周期的命令。

## Non-goals
- 不开放 sub-agent 的 Git 写入能力。

## Task Orchestration
- wave: 1
  - sub-agent:config [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => git config --local user.name Agent (skill: $normal-flow)
  - sub-agent:add-worktree [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => git worktree add ../other-worktree branch (skill: $normal-flow)
  - sub-agent:remove-worktree [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => git worktree remove ../other-worktree (skill: $normal-flow)
  - sub-agent:config-chain [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => git config --get user.name && git config --global user.name Agent (skill: $normal-flow)
  - sub-agent:apply-chain [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => git apply --check patch.diff || git apply patch.diff (skill: $normal-flow)

## Acceptance & Validation
- checker 必须拒绝所有 Git 配置和 worktree 写入命令，包括链式命令。

## Assumptions/Defaults
- 用于负例：已确定
</proposed_plan>
